state:
**Goal `ext-image`: Stages 2 to 5 are done on disk, and Stage 6 (the feature proofs) is in progress.** ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* settle the design, and no session re-decides it.

The component is embedded and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). The `Novis\Image` builder is Novis source in `extensions/image/nvs/`, and `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`'s fragment says what it has and lacks. `nvs meta --json` lists the built-in classes, the roster gives a `Novis\` member the path `novis/<tail>/<member>` and an enum the path `types/Novis-Image-<Enum>`, and `docs/reference/novis/Image-Image.md` is the class intro.

**Every `Novis\Image\Image` member the builder has, `Color::rgba`, `Color::hex` and the six enums owe nothing.** `Color` is pinned from Novis by `tests/conformance/novis/image-a-colour-checks-its-channels.nvst` and from Rust by `crates/nvs-cli/tests/image_color.rs`; the enums by `tests/conformance/novis/image-each-enum-case-reaches-the-step-it-names.nvst`. `Color::rgba` now throws for a `NAN` alpha instead of passing it to the guest. What is left of the acceptance check is `Codec`'s three members and `composite`.

**The acceptance check cannot pass as written:** `dossier-novis-image-pipeline` names `Novis\Image\Image::composite`, which the builder does not have (`rule:core-classes/image-pipeline` lists it as missing, and the guest's `run` skips `composite`), so `--only` refuses the whole list. Either `composite` is built or it leaves the check; see the next group's last item.

items.text: **`Novis\Image\Codec`'s members, and its class card**: `nv proofs` says `Novis\Image\Codec` has no class card; it is the component's manifest-declared class, so its card belongs in `extensions/image/manifest.json`. Then `Codec::info`, `::run` and `::variants` owe what `bun nv proofs --id 'Novis\Image\Codec::info'` prints; the Rust `covers:` markers are already in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_pipeline.rs`. Anchor: `extensions/image/manifest.json:34`.

**`composite` in the acceptance check**: build `Image::composite` (builder in `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:152`, the guest's `composite` step in `extensions/image/src/ops.rs:1`), or take it out of `dossier-novis-image-pipeline` in `data/goals/ext-image.json` with the reason in the goal file. The goal file's builder item names `composite`, so building it is the default. Building it makes `Blend` usable, and `docs/examples/types/Novis-Image-Blend/about.md` then needs its last paragraph rewritten.

backlog: `Image::mime` and `Image::extension` are builder members the check does not name; `bun nv proofs --id` says what they owe (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).
The growth of several benches reads `unclear` at 256 iterations of a 4x4 image; `bun nv scaling` owns the ramp (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).

`format`'s `progressive` and `effort` options are accepted and no encoder reads them (`extensions/image/src/encode.rs` module doc); `docs/examples/novis/Image-Image/format/about.md` says so, and wiring them changes that page.

`Image::info` returned `exif: null` for a JPEG whose EXIF block has only an orientation tag, and the WIT `exif` is `list<tuple<string, string>>` while the Novis `Info` shape says `?array<string>` (`wit/image.wit:104`, `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:42`); whether the two agree is not checked.
